data.prometheus.yml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 5s
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: ganjj
    kubernetes_sd_configs:
      - role: pod
        namespaces:
          names: [ganjj-n2]
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape]
        action: keep
        regex: "true"
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_ip, __meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_port]
        action: replace
        regex: (.+);(.+)
        replacement: $1:$2
        target_label: __address__
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_path]
        target_label: __metrics_path__
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
        target_label: service
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
        target_label: pod

data.datasources.yaml:
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
  - name: Prometheus
    uid: ganjj-prometheus
    type: prometheus
    access: proxy
    url: http://ganjj-prometheus:9090
    isDefault: true
data.dashboards.yaml:
apiVersion: 1
providers:
  - name: GANJJ
    type: file
    options:
      path: /var/lib/grafana/dashboards

data.client.json: {"uid": "ganjj-client", "title": "GANJJ / client", "schemaVersion": 39, "version": 1, "refresh": "10s", "time": {"from": "now-30m", "to": "now"}, "panels": [{"id": 1, "title": "Requisi\u00e7\u00f5es/s", "type": "timeseries", "datasource": {"type": "prometheus", "uid": "ganjj-prometheus"}, "gridPos": {"h": 8, "w": 8, "x": 0, "y": 0}, "targets": [{"refId": "A", "expr": "sum(rate(client_http_requests_total[$__rate_interval]))"}], "fieldConfig": {"defaults": {"unit": "reqps"}, "overrides": []}}, {"id": 2, "title": "Erros/s", "type": "timeseries", "datasource": {"type": "prometheus", "uid": "ganjj-prometheus"}, "gridPos": {"h": 8, "w": 8, "x": 8, "y": 0}, "targets": [{"refId": "A", "expr": "sum(rate(client_http_requests_total{status=~\"5..\"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)"}], "fieldConfig": {"defaults": {"unit": "reqps"}, "overrides": []}}, {"id": 3, "title": "Lat\u00eancia p95", "type": "timeseries", "datasource": {"type": "prometheus", "uid": "ganjj-prometheus"}, "gridPos": {"h": 8, "w": 8, "x": 16, "y": 0}, "targets": [{"refId": "A", "expr": "histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(client_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))"}], "fieldConfig": {"defaults": {"unit": "s"}, "overrides": []}}]}
data.authorization.json: {"uid": "ganjj-authorization", "title": "GANJJ / authorization", "schemaVersion": 39, "version": 1, "refresh": "10s", "time": {"from": "now-30m", "to": "now"}, "panels": [{"id": 1, "title": "Requisi\u00e7\u00f5es/s", "type": "timeseries", "datasource": {"type": "prometheus", "uid": "ganjj-prometheus"}, "gridPos": {"h": 8, "w": 8, "x": 0, "y": 0}, "targets": [{"refId": "A", "expr": "sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application=\"authorization\"}[$__rate_interval]))"}], "fieldConfig": {"defaults": {"unit": "reqps"}, "overrides": []}}, {"id": 2, "title": "Erros/s", "type": "timeseries", "datasource": {"type": "prometheus", "uid": "ganjj-prometheus"}, "gridPos": {"h": 8, "w": 8, "x": 8, "y": 0}, "targets": [{"refId": "A", "expr": "sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application=\"authorization\",status=~\"5..\"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)"}], "fieldConfig": {"defaults": {"unit": "reqps"}, "overrides": []}}, {"id": 3, "title": "Lat\u00eancia p95", "type": "timeseries", "datasource": {"type": "prometheus", "uid": "ganjj-prometheus"}, "gridPos": {"h": 8, "w": 8, "x": 16, "y": 0}, "targets": [{"refId": "A", "expr": "histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{application=\"authorization\"}[$__rate_interval])))"}], "fieldConfig": {"defaults": {"unit": "s"}, "overrides": []}}]}
data.support.json: {"uid": "ganjj-support", "title": "GANJJ / support", "schemaVersion": 39, "version": 1, "refresh": "10s", "time": {"from": "now-30m", "to": "now"}, "panels": [{"id": 1, "title": "Eventos por resultado", "type": "timeseries", "datasource": {"type": "prometheus", "uid": "ganjj-prometheus"}, "gridPos": {"h": 8, "w": 8, "x": 0, "y": 0}, "targets": [{"refId": "A", "expr": "sum by (result) (rate(support_events_total[$__rate_interval]))"}], "fieldConfig": {"defaults": {"unit": "reqps"}, "overrides": []}}, {"id": 2, "title": "Entregas por canal e status", "type": "timeseries", "datasource": {"type": "prometheus", "uid": "ganjj-prometheus"}, "gridPos": {"h": 8, "w": 8, "x": 8, "y": 0}, "targets": [{"refId": "A", "expr": "sum by (channel,status) (rate(support_notifications_total[$__rate_interval]))"}], "fieldConfig": {"defaults": {"unit": "reqps"}, "overrides": []}}, {"id": 3, "title": "Dura\u00e7\u00e3o p95 por canal", "type": "timeseries", "datasource": {"type": "prometheus", "uid": "ganjj-prometheus"}, "gridPos": {"h": 8, "w": 8, "x": 16, "y": 0}, "targets": [{"refId": "A", "expr": "histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le,channel) (rate(support_send_duration_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))"}], "fieldConfig": {"defaults": {"unit": "s"}, "overrides": []}}]}
